entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Dexippus was an Ancient Greek Neoplatonist philosopher from the 4th century AD, whose wrote a commentary on the Categories of Aristotle which is partially extant.

Dexippus was born in the 3rd century AD in the Roman province of Pontus Polemoniacus, in modern-day Turkey, and died in 350 CE in Alexandria, Egypt.

This philosopher played a crucial role in the development of Neoplatonism, a school of thought that emphasized the spiritual and metaphysical aspects of Plato's philosophy. Dexippus' commentary on Aristotle's Categories, which is now partially extant, provides valuable insights into the philosophical debates of the time.

Dexippus' significance lies in his contribution to the development of Neoplatonism, which had a lasting impact on Western philosophy. His work continues to be studied by scholars today, offering a unique perspective on the intellectual currents of the ancient world.
